title: Job
description: profiles/<slug>/jobs/<id>.json: a one-time job that, at its time, creates and starts a ticket or runs a shell command. Type Job in src/core/types.ts; written by Store.saveJob (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename) from src/schedules/jobs.ts. Created with every required field (state scheduled, firedAt null, result null). Files from older versions may have state missed; the Store reads that as skipped with result.message 'was due while the computer was off' and does not rewrite the file. Unknown fields must be kept.

id.description: 8 base36 chars (newId). Equals the file name without .json.

state.description: JobState: scheduled, then running, then done or failed; or cancelled, or skipped (a command job due while the computer was off). missed: older files only (read as skipped).

sourceTicketId.description: Ticket whose board run scheduled it; null when the user or CLI did.

changedBy.description: The last change, cancel or run now made by a board run; cleared when the user changes it after that.

result.description: JobResult; null until it ran (and again while it runs).

exitCode.description: Command action: exit code, null when it was killed.

output.description: The last 4 KB of the command's output.

message.description: Why it failed or was skipped or cancelled, in plain words.

ticketAction.description: Create a ticket and start it right away (like a schedule's fire).

commandAction.description: Run a shell command in the board folder: no ticket, no Claude.

ifLate.description: When the board sees it more than 10 min late (computer off): skip it (default, also when missing) or run it anyway.
